t: This is the New Peckham Mosque on Cobourg Road in Southwark. The building was designed by Richard Norman Shaw, a British architect who worked from the 1870s to the 1900s. He's known for his country houses and for commercial buildings, and he is considered to be among the greatest of British architects. His influence on architectural style was strongest in the 1880s and 1890s, which tells you something about the age and pedigree of the building you're looking at.
